title: 第十二章 冷月斩
slug: 武神空间全本免费-武神空间最新章节列表
content_zh:
那个黑衣青年力量比叶希文还大，只停滞了一瞬间，就继续砍了下来。
不过只是这一瞬间，就已经够了，叶希文已经做好了完全的准备了，奔雷手，八响。
“雷厉风行！”叶希文大喝，右手缠绕着雷状的真气，一掌拍进了黑衣青年的胸膛。
“嘭！”那个黑衣青年被一掌直接拍中，身体如同断了线的风筝一般，倒飞了出去，高高飞起，然后狠狠跌落到了地上，肋骨都被叶希文拍断了很多根，气喘如牛。
黑衣青年瞪大了眼睛看着叶希文，有些难以置信的说道：“你。。。你居然敢阴我！”
更不敢相信，叶希文居然这么疯狂，为了攻击到他，居然硬挨了他这一击，堪称疯狂。
“嘿嘿！”叶希文给自己止了血，脸色有些惨白，刚才被劈开的伤口深可见骨，血流不止，现在叶希文才有空给自己稍微止血。
叶希文没有耽误工夫，朝着那个倒在地上，浑身无力的黑衣青年冲去。
“你。。。你不能杀我！”黑衣青年这时候终于有些惊恐的说道，“我是张家的少主，你要是杀了我，你会有大麻烦的！”
“战斗一旦开始，就是你死我亡了！”叶希文明白，不能放走了这个黑衣青年，不然将来的麻烦，肯定非常大，这段时间的经验都告诉他，妇人之仁不能有，这个世界充满着弱肉强食的丛林法则。
叶希文一步一步的走向了那个黑衣青年。
“你去死吧！”那个黑衣青年脸上突然露出狰狞的表情，手臂猛然一挥，一刀月牙刀气席卷而出，朝着叶希文斩去。
叶希文脚下一踏，身形移位，躲过了这一次绝地反击，他一再告诫自己要小心谨慎，怎么可能不防备着。
奔雷手，八响！
轰隆隆的声音在树林间回响，那个黑衣青年脸上的惊恐越来越强烈。
“嘭！”
一声惨叫之后，那个黑衣青年终于带着深深的不甘心气绝身亡。
叶希文见那个黑衣青年终于被他打死，顿时松了口气，一屁股坐到地上，大口大口的喘着粗气。
没有多做休息，叶希文站了起来，开始在三个人身上搜刮起来，杀人，夺宝，往往都是一起的。
在两个后天五重的高手的身上一共搜出了下品灵石二十块，还有银票一百两，然后叶希文又开始在那个黑衣青年的身上搜了起来，叶希文惊喜的发现，这个黑衣青年的身上，居然有一个储物戒指，而且大小还不小，居然有超过一百立方米左右的大小。

要知道，储物戒指之类的，空间类物品是最贵的，哪怕只有十立方米的大小，起码也需要一百块灵石，而一百立方米的，起码也是要上千块下品灵石的，在一元宗也就只有那些先天境界的长老才有财力买的起，叶希文就只在自己的养父叶空明身上看到过。
没想到这个黑衣青年居然能有一百立方米的储物戒指，果然不愧是张家的少主。
得到了储物戒指之后，叶希文探入神识一看，顿时大喜，果然，和这个黑衣青年的继续相比，那两个后天五重的高手，就是小巫见大巫了。
这储物戒中光是下品灵石就超过了五百块，这使得叶希文在一段时间中都不用为了灵石的事情发愁，除了灵石之后，还有银票一万两，当然最让叶希文惊喜的是，这空间戒指中，居然有一本武学秘籍，正是刚才那个黑衣青年，凝气成罡的绝学，能让这个黑衣青年在后天六重的时候，就拥有先天境界的威能，这部功法当然颇为不凡。
这个功法叫做《冷月斩》，竟然是一部先天级别的功法，冷月斩，一共有三层，第一层叫新月斩，第二层是缺月斩，第三层是圆月斩，练成新月斩就可以比拟中级功法的威力，练成缺月斩就能比拟高级功法的威力，如果将第三层圆月斩也练成了，就能发挥出先天级别功法的威力。
堪称是威力无穷！
原本叶希文还在考虑以后要学一门兵器方面的武技，弥补短板，现在有了这本《冷月斩》就完全弥补了这方面的问题了，《冷月斩》既可以用长刀来发出，也可以凝气成罡来代替，甚至其中还有一套独特的凝气成罡的法门，使得真气化成的长刀坚固无比，能够发挥出《冷月斩》的威力。

content_en:
The young man in black was more powerful than Ye Xiwen, and he only stopped for a moment before continuing to chop down.
But just this moment was enough, Ye Xiwen was fully prepared, Thunder Hand, Eight Rings.
"Thunder and force!" Ye Xiwen shouted, his right hand wrapped with thunder-like Qi, and he slapped the chest of the young man in black with his palm.
"Bang!" The young man in black was hit directly by a palm, and his body flew out like a kite with its string broken. He flew high and then fell hard to the ground. Many of his ribs were broken by Ye Xiwen, and he was panting like an ox.
The young man in black looked at Ye Xiwen with wide eyes and said with some disbelief: "You...you actually dare to trick me!"
I couldn't even believe that Ye Xiwen was so crazy. In order to attack him, he actually took a blow from him. It was called crazy.
"Hey!" Ye Xiwen stopped the bleeding for himself. His face was a little pale. The wound that was opened just now was so deep that the bones were visible and the blood was flowing. Now Ye Xiwen had time to stop the bleeding for a while.
Ye Xiwen wasted no time and rushed towards the young man in black who fell to the ground, unable to do anything.
"You... you can't kill me!" The young man in black finally said in fear, "I am the young master of the Zhang family. If you kill me, you will be in big trouble!"
"Once the battle starts, it will be your death and my death!" Ye Xiwen knew that he could not let go of the young man in black, otherwise he would be in great trouble in the future. His experience during this period told him that women cannot be kind, and this world is full of jungle laws where the weak prey on the strong.
Ye Xiwen walked towards the young man in black step by step.
"Go to hell!" The young man in black suddenly showed a ferocious expression on his face, and with a sudden wave of his arm, a crescent blade swept out and slashed towards Ye Xiwen.
Ye Xiwen stepped down and shifted his body, avoiding this desperate counterattack. He repeatedly warned himself to be careful, how could he not be on guard.
Thunder running hand, eight rings!
The rumbling sound echoed through the woods, and the fear on the face of the young man in black became more and more intense.
"Bang!"
After a scream, the young man in black finally died with deep reluctance.
Seeing that the young man in black was finally beaten to death, Ye Xiwen breathed a sigh of relief and sat down on the ground, breathing heavily.
Without taking much rest, Ye Xiwen stood up and began to search for the three people. Killing people and grabbing treasures were often done together.
A total of 20 low-grade spiritual stones and one hundred taels of silver notes were found on the bodies of the two acquired fifth-level masters. Then Ye Xiwen began to search the body of the young man in black. Ye Xiwen was surprised to find that the young man in black actually had a storage ring on his body, and the size was not small. It was over one hundred cubic meters in size.
You know, storage rings and other space-based items are the most expensive. Even if they are only ten cubic meters in size, they will cost at least one hundred spiritual stones, and one hundred cubic meters will cost at least a thousand low-grade spiritual stones. Only the elders in the Yiyuan Sect who have the financial resources to buy them can afford them. Ye Xiwen has only seen it on his adoptive father Ye Kongming.
Unexpectedly, this young man in black can actually have a storage ring of one hundred cubic meters. He is indeed the young master of the Zhang family.
After getting the storage ring, Ye Xiwen looked into his consciousness and was overjoyed. Sure enough, compared with the performance of this young man in black, the two acquired fifth-level masters were nothing but dwarfs.
The storage ring alone contains more than 500 low-grade spirit stones, which allows Ye Xiwen to not worry about the spirit stones for a period of time. In addition to the spirit stones, there are also 10,000 taels of silver notes. Of course, what surprises Ye Xiwen the most is that in this space ring, there is actually a martial arts secret book. It is the young man in black who just made the magic of condensing energy into a gang.The young man in black already possesses the power of the innate realm when he is at the sixth level of acquired life. This technique is certainly quite extraordinary.
This skill is called "Leng Yue Slash", and it is actually an innate-level skill. Cold Moon Slash has three levels. The first level is called New Moon Slash, the second level is Missing Moon Slash, and the third level is Full Moon Slash. Once you have mastered New Moon Slash, you can compare with the power of the intermediate skill. If you have mastered Missing Moon Slash, you can compare with the power of high-level skills. If you have also mastered the third level of Full Moon Slash, you can exert the power of the innate level skill.
It can be said to be infinitely powerful!
Originally, Ye Xiwen was still thinking about learning a martial arts skill with weapons in the future to make up for his shortcomings. Now with the book "Leng Yue Slash", he can completely make up for this problem. "Leng Yue Slash" can be fired with a long knife, or it can be condensed into a sword. There is even a unique method of condensing energy into a sword, which makes the long sword made of true energy extremely strong and able to exert the power of "Leng Yue Slash".
